features.feature: All in-scope Codex/Claude role prompts carry lane-appropriate canonical rollout guidance without becoming gate authority
Verifier-owned rollout report rejects caller membership, verdict and aggregate fields
Real cohort freezes eligibility, window and full membership with at least three matched pairs and three cases per arm
Cohort mutations reject eligible omission, ineligible addition, window/membership/order/digest drift and insufficient cardinality
Report receipt binds membership, records, hashes, cost, rounds, waivers, adapters and full-3x2 provenance
Every created runner/evaluator/smoke producer-consumer path is artifact-kind-correct and mapped into the canonical verification topology

features.feature: Docs-only, legacy and single-outcome controls prove zero supported false blocks
Every registered seeded defect class has overall false-pass rate 0, omission detection 100%, and incomplete/non-omission misses fail closed
Flat thresholds also require zero false blocks and mislabeled 3x1, nonpositive waiver delta, nonshrinking checks and supported adapters
Unknown, partial, unsupported, incomplete or disagreeing campaigns fail promotion deterministically
Opt-in enforce consumes the exact current signed PASS report at CLI and lifecycle consumers
Enforcement requires genuine current full three rounds by two independent supported hosts; degraded 3x1 is non-authority
Missing, stale, tampered, failing or weakened report/quorum/threshold input fails closed at the real consumer
Rollback changes blocking only and preserves all reports, receipts, transitions, diagnostics and history
Canonical plan/CLI docs update only after real evidence with exact measured results, commands and authority boundary
Selective per-Story/per-policy enforcement stays excluded until Wave 3A exists
features.excluded_by: Flat Wave 4 explicitly excludes selective applicability; Wave 3A remains mandatory for that claim.
